title: Original Homemade Italian Beef
description: Homemade Italian beef is easy to make in the slow cooker with this family-favorite recipe. Just chuck roast, some dry salad dressing mix, and pepperoncini.
ingredients: 3 (1 ounce) packages dry Italian salad dressing mix

steps.text: Place roast into a slow cooker and rub dressing mix over top. Pour water around roast. Cover and cook on High until meat is tender and can be easily pulled apart with a fork, 5 to 6 hours.
Remove meat and shred with two forks. Return meat to the slow cooker; add pepperoncini and as much pepperoncini juice as you like for additional flavor. Cover and cook for 1 more hour.

video.description: Looking for effortless dinners that practically cook themselves? In this video, Nicole shares five easy and delicious crockpot meals—each made with just five ingredients! From hearty Slow Cooker Italian Beef Sandwiches to creamy Crockpot Chicken Enchilada Casserole, these simple recipes are perfect for busy weeknights. Plus, you'll love the sweet and savory flavors of Slow Cooker Peach Pork Picante, the comforting classic Crockpot Beef Stroganoff, and the rich, cheesy Slow Cooker Boursin Chicken and Pasta.
